question: Nuts, vegetable oil and fish are rich sources of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Omega-3.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Omega- 3 adipose acids **are vital to proper cell functioning and play an important part in colorful fleshly systems.
 
• Some food sources include **adipose fish, seaweed, flaxseeds, and chia seeds.**
 
• Omega- 3s are a type of essential adipose acid, meaning people must gain them from their diet.
 
• There are** three main types of omega- 3 adipose acids DHA, EPA, and ALA.** Fish and seafood sources of omega- 3 tend to be advanced in DHA and EPA, while factory sources are generally advanced in ALA.
 
• Eating a variety of omega- 3 foods is important for optimal health.
